description:
After T0 UserMessage returns {self, %VLines{lines: lines}, nil}. After T4, it can return a proper %VZone{} tree with no internal painting.

File: apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/user_message.ex

New render/2:
  def render(%__MODULE__{} = self, %RenderContext{} = ctx) do
    {self, build_vnode(self, ctx), nil}
  end

  defp build_vnode(%__MODULE__{text: t}, _ctx) when t in ["", nil],
    do: %VDOM.VFlow{children: []}

  defp build_vnode(%__MODULE__{text: text}, %RenderContext{theme: theme, width: width}) do
    if String.trim(text) == "" do
      %VDOM.VFlow{children: []}
    else
      md       = Markdown.new(text, theme, padding_x: 1)
      md_lines = Markdown.render(md, width)
      bg_fn    = fn l -> Theme.bg(theme, :user_message_bg, pad_to_width(l, width)) end
      styled   = [bg_fn.("") | Enum.map(md_lines, bg_fn)] ++ [bg_fn.("")]
      %VDOM.VZone{type: :prompt, id: "user",
                  children: %VDOM.VLines{lines: styled}}
    end
  end

Delete from user_message.ex:
- @osc133_zone_start, @osc133_zone_end, @osc133_zone_final (lines 10–12)
- wrap_osc133/1 (lines 57–65)

Tests: Empty text → empty VFlow. Non-empty → VZone wrapping VLines. Paint and verify OSC 133 prompt markers appear on first/last line. No raw \e]133; literals remain in the file.
